sheets.title: A · 작업 개수형
sheets.detail: Variant A retains the Graze Custom-derived contrasting creamy-white squared shoulder and divided upper-chest repair caps over sage/olive leg armor. Reinterpret as sturdy casual utility swordsman, helmet bigger and more expressive with single simple orange slit, dark elbow hinge discs simplified, prominent big gauntlets and chunky wedge toes. White modular shoulder cap and external dark joint are the single detail vignette, with one big pin rather than dozens of screws. One red-lit straight blade in hand, other hand free. Two action poses are low ready squat and sweeping one-handed slash. Exact title "A · 작업 개수형". Strong blocky industrial identity, matte illustrated flat materials.
sheets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: Image 1 is the existing individual HEX BLADE wearable exosuit concept sheet. Reinterpret this SAME concept as a much more CASUAL, strongly STYLIZED game character sheet. The user finds the source too semi-realistic. The change MUST be immediately obvious in shape design and illustration, not a subtle rendering filter.
Style/medium: bold appealing 2D cartoon game concept art, thick confident dark-navy/violet outer contours, sparse thinner interior lines, LARGE clean interlocking color shapes, crisp TWO-TONE cel shadows, matte flat graphic surfaces, one simple flat highlight per major plate at most. Cheerful energetic readable visual language. Fresh cream and sage/olive with orange visor and coral/red blade; small cyan/mint power accent. Strong silhouette readability when shrunk to thumbnail.
Shape redesign: proportion the full suit about 5.5-6 helmet-heights tall (the source is too long and anatomically realistic); helmet visually larger, torso compact, midriff filled with a simple flexible dark connector, hips and thighs sturdy, calves shorter, hands/forearms and wedge boots exaggerated into generous broad simple shapes. Simplify each complex mechanical assembly to one or two clear hinges. Keep recognizable reference form language: Graze's clipped angular shoulder caps, visible dark joint connections and wedge helmet; Reginlaze's wrapping divided chest plates, angled green shoulder cap and large gauntlets, according to variant. Broad beveled planes with slightly softened corners are fine, not round mascot balls. All details are GRAPHIC, no intricate pistons/wires. Retain coherent adult wearable proportions, not 3-head super-deformed toy and not giant mobile suit. Keep toughness and sword-action appeal while becoming casual.
Remove 80 percent of micro-detail: no tiny bolts/rivets, no screws everywhere, no scratches, no chipped paint, no rust, no surface dirt, no brushed steel, no grainy paint texture, no crosshatching, no metallic specular, no ambient occlusion, no gradient realism, no photorealistic lights, no rendered model-kit look, no detailed anatomy, no realistic military catalog style. Avoid preserving the source's long skinny 8-head limbs.
Human fit invariant: head inside helmet, hands inside gloves, feet inside boots, human elbow/knee axes match suit hinges. The cutaway human is ALSO drawn as a simple stylized full-size adult orange silhouette with cartoon head proportions to fit the stylized helmet; no realistic muscular/skin shading, no tiny seated torso pilot. Retain directly wearable suit concept and rear clamshell entry. Nominal concept height2.2m, reference adult1.75m. If including small scale pair, human is about 80% of suit height on same baseline, not half as tall.
Composition: redraw the landscape sheet as a clean designed art board with one LARGE full-body three-quarter hero on left, smaller front/back at center, simple whole-body orange wearer cutaway on right, a small open rear entry sketch, ONE simplified joint/armor detail, and TWO lively action thumbnails along bottom. Less clutter than original engineering plate. Whole hero, both boots and weapon tips visible. Match colors/armor identity across all views. Background clean warm ivory with sparse broad mint/lilac graphic accents, NO technical grid, no decorative filler charts. Flat grounding oval shadows only, no realistic ground.
Keep short Korean labels legible and sparse: "HEX BLADE / EXOSUIT", variant title specified below, "정면", "후면", "착용 구조", "후면 개방", "2.2m", "사람 1.75m". No paragraph text, no excessive dimension arrows, no unnecessary branding.

sheets.title: B · 고기동 근접형
sheets.detail: Variant B retains the Reginlaze Julietta-derived forest/sage green armor, forward-curved ridge helmet, angled shoulder caps, cream wrapping chest, pale knee bands and big dark forearm gauntlets. Reinterpret into casual agile dual-sword character: helmet a little larger, upper-body lean but compact, big simplified gauntlets, short wedge boots; sharp clean diagonals and flow rather than skinny realistic legs. Keep TWO short straight red-edged cutters, one in each hand; clear simple human wrist/glove hinge in detail vignette. Two action poses are low dash and crossing twin slash, stylized motion streaks. Exact title "B · 고기동 근접형". Do not add giant Reginlaze Julia wings or mechanical stilts.

sheets.title: C · 혼합 검격형
sheets.detail: Variant C retains the balanced Graze/Reginlaze hybrid in dominant cream with sage hip/thigh accents, continuous orange visor, flat cyan back power modules and one red sword. Reinterpret into the MAIN HERO casual chunky industrial exosuit: larger clipped-corner shoulder plates on simple graphite pivots, compact broken-U chest, filled flexible dark waist, confident big glove/fist and broad wedge boots. Most armor panels are one bold cream shape each. Cheerful tough character appeal through proportions, not human face or goofy eyes. One detail vignette showing shoulder cap rising clear of simple hinge. Two action poses are two-handed sword ready and dynamic rotational sword slash. Exact title "C · 혼합 검격형". Bold recognizable thumbnail silhouette, not source semi-realistic proportion.

sheets.title: D · 중장갑 돌파형
sheets.detail: Variant D retains the widest heavy breacher cream/olive armor, massive clipped-box shoulder caps, big armored forearms, reinforced thighs, wide wedge boots with short heel stabilizer, heavy red-edged straight cleaver-sword. Reinterpret into a casual powerfully chunky armored adult suit around about 5.5 helmet-heights tall: broad compact chest, shorter calves, large expressive gauntlets, thick simple armor blocks with clear simple gaps for elbow/knee. Make heavy form distinct from others, but no tank mascot and no pilot inside a giant mech. Detail vignette shows one large simple knee axis circle and a tiny folding heel support. TWO action poses are planted sword guard and powerful overhead chop, wide graphic motion marks. Exact title "D · 중장갑 돌파형". Remove realistic supporting rods and wiring clusters; retain only simplified load brace.
